name: move_vault_file
description: Renames or moves a vault file or artifact from path to toPath. The folder above toPath must already exist, and nothing may be at toPath; the move never replaces anything. An artifact's name keeps ending in ".artifact", and a plain file's may not. Moving keeps the file's versions and history. Move folders with move_vault_folder.

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces. Must satisfy the required format.

path.description: The file to move. Must satisfy the required format.

toPath.description: Its new path, including its name. Must satisfy the required format.
